scope: Canonical native URL intake, bootstrap fencing and Android Back integration
guarantees: Only canonical HTTPS probpera.ru entry paths and approved atlas/book parameters are accepted.
Launch and warm URL events wait for the existing archive/book runtime and fail closed on missing, denied or unavailable records.
A newer ordinary in-app selection or Back action cancels a late native navigation resolution.
Android Back closes active layers by explicit priority, then uses existing browser history; no implicit native exit is requested.
The integration reuses the existing InterfaceLanguageProvider, atlas URL state, archive and publication gate; it creates no second router, catalogue, globe, renderer or entitlement store.

A fresh current-main native artifact: the successful cloud iOS binary is a separately identified source-only historical projection.
OS-level PWA installation and standalone relaunch.
Full S04 acceptance, S03 first-open acceptance, later globe lifecycle, offline, child, commerce, localization, store, legal and release-candidate gates.
